ProxyPiTester v1.3.4
====================

UK residential proxy test & app routing for ProxyPi.
https://proxypi.co.uk

If the window "disappears"
--------------------------
Look near the clock (system tray) for the ProxyPiTester icon and click it.
"Minimize to tray" is OFF by default in 1.3.2+.
Speed Test downloads a sample of the 100 MB test file through your proxy.

If it truly will not start
--------------------------
1. Extract the zip fully to a folder first
2. Right-click ProxyPiTester.exe → Properties → Unblock → OK
3. Email support@proxypi.co.uk with ProxyPiTester-startup.log (next to the EXE)

Quick start
-----------
1. Double-click ProxyPiTester.exe
2. Log in with your ProxyPi account
3. Login and Load My Proxy
4. Test Proxy / Speed Test
5. Open apps from Active Apps

Support: support@proxypi.co.uk
